This voltfruit from Gerudo Desert has been charred to bring out its sweet and sour flavors.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Roasted Voltfruits are a type of [[Roasted Food]], and they are made when Voltfruits are burned by Fire or a [[Scorching Climate]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} The roasting of the Voltfruits brings out their sweet and sour flavors. Roasted Voltfruits restore three-quarters of a [[Heart]] to [[Link]]'s [[Life Gauge]] when they are eaten. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Roasted Voltfruits reappear in {{TotK}}, once again being a variety of [[Roasted Food]]. They are made by letting [[Voltfruit]]s come into contact with [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. Doing this results in both their sweet and sour flavors being brought out. [[Link]] can eat a Roasted Voltfruit to heal three-quarters of a [[Heart]] to his [[Life Gauge]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Roasted Food * Voltfruit }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Roasted Food |items= BotW, TotK }}
